prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en uppsättning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "set (group)".
Scene: An open organised toolkit holding a coherent group of screwdriver, pliers, spanner and hammer in fitted compartments, no branding.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "uppsättning = set; a group that belongs together.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han har en uppsättning verktyg.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
